scope: Public root scheduler Store over two independently opened stock native hosts and connector pools; disposable MySQL8.4.11
assertions: Exactly one simultaneous schedule lease claimant wins
Exactly one simultaneous run lease claimant wins
Losing owner cannot release or overwrite live lease
Losing contender can claim after release
Former owner cannot release newly owned lease
Direct database inspection verifies winner retained after rejected release, new owner after reclaim, and empty owner after final release
fixture_policy: Unique owned schedule/run IDs; cleanup by exact ID; no production jobs or schema changes
